ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution with a low white-to-black ratio estimated at less than 15% across visible surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant continuous dark pigmentation across both lobes; small localized high-intensity (white) clusters are visible on the distal tip of the left lobe and along the inferior midline.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle approximately between 30 and 45 degrees relative to the vertical axis of the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible across the entire trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by jagged peaks and varying pixel-amplitude valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a strong convex curvature transitioning into a jagged, roughly linear trailing edge toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (white on black) localized on the outer tip and leading edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast diagonal linear disruptions are detectable on the mid-to-lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of barnacle-related scarring and possible parasitic lesions on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical high-frequency noise patterns caused by water drainage (droplets) along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
